title: THE ALERT LANE, FIRST FOR THE CRIER
why: His order of 2026-10-09: the raid text reads like Call of Duty, Fortnite or ARC Raiders, where a threat is a callout of its own. A Crier marking you was one more message row that the next remark pushed down, and a second MARKED row under the compass flashed its own sentence ten times a second for as long as the mark ran. Lines that warn of danger, critical lines and extraction lines now take one alert slot at the top of the message band: a dark red plate for a threat with an accent bar and a warning glyph, the headline in the callout size and an optional detail under it. It fades in, holds perfectly steady, and fades out; a remark said meanwhile goes to the feed rows under it instead of pushing it off. His Crier lines keep his words exactly and are the first alerts; the fire line holds while the mark runs. The flashing MARKED row is gone; the red edge of the screen still shows the mark.
now: Danger, critical and extraction lines take their own steady alert slot at the top of the screen, starting with his Crier lines.
